Name: Greenhouse Mapper
Author: SeaQueen91
Description:
[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]Your entire greenhouse, at a glance. [/size][/color][/b]

Lost track of where you planted something? Wondering which crops are ready to harvest—or which ones still need water? Greenhouse Mapper turns your greenhouse into a full-screen, interactive overview, helping you find your plants and plan your next visit.

It reads your greenhouse’s live layout, so it works with the vanilla greenhouse and custom greenhouse maps—not just one fixed floor plan.

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4][u]See what’s growing[/u][/size][/color][/b]
View your greenhouse with recognizable item icons for:
   
[list]
[*]Crops[/*]
[*]Fruit trees and their fruit[/*]
[*]Bushes and their produce[/*]
[*]Giant crops[/*]
[*]Items displayed on Wood Signs[/*]
[/list]Tillable ground appears brown, while other tiles remain black for a clear, uncluttered view. A white marker shows your farmer’s position when you’re inside the greenhouse.

Zoom with the mouse wheel and drag to pan around larger layouts.

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4][u]Find plants quickly[/u][/size][/color][/b]
Open the toggleable vegetation list to browse your greenhouse’s plants and see how many of each are planted.
  
[list]
[*]Search by plant name.[/*]
[*]Sort alphabetically or by planted quantity.[/*]
[*]Hover over a list entry to highlight matching map tiles in red while keeping their item icons visible.[/*]
[*]Click an entry to center the map on its locations, adjusting the zoom to help frame multiple plantings.[/*]
[*]Use the Favorite checkbox to pin frequently checked plants to the top.[/*]
[/list][b] [/b]
[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4][u]Check crop status[/u][/size][/color][/b]
Toggle three independent overlays:
[list]
[*]Growing: highlights crops that are still growing.[/*]
[*]Harvestable: highlights crops ready to collect.[/*]
[*]Needs water: highlights planted crop tiles that currently require watering.[/*]
[/list]Hover over crops for growth information, including their growth phase and estimated days remaining. Fruit trees and bushes also have tooltips showing their identity and applicable status.

Custom bush harvest timing depends on the bush’s own rules. The map does not invent a countdown when that information cannot be determined.

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4][u]Keep your signs useful[/u][/size][/color][/b]
Wood Signs appear on the map when the item icon is placed on them. Blank Wood Signs appear as purple squares, with an explanation in the map legend.

When signs are included in the vegetation list, their displayed items are searchable—even if you haven’t planted that item yet. Sign-only entries are labeled sign rather than counted as plants. This can help you find where your sign, and future plot of crops, is located.

Use the Signs checkbox beside Sort to show or hide sign-only list entries. Their map icons remain visible either way.

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4][u]Check your greenhouse from anywhere[/u][/size][/color][/b]
You don’t need to walk back inside just to check your plants!
Press Shift + M to view a previously visited greenhouse remotely. If several eligible greenhouses are available, a picker lets you choose which one to inspect.

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4][u]Export your greenhouse map[/u][/size][/color][/b]
Want to save your layout or share it with someone?
Click Export UI PNG to capture the current view, including its zoom level and visible interface. Each export receives a timestamped filename, and the success notification displays the complete destination path.
Mouse tile coordinates are also shown along the bottom of the map, making individual positions easier to identify.

[color=#6aa84f][size=4][b][u]Controls[/u][/b]  [/size][/color]     
[table][tr][td][b]Action[/b][/td]
[td][b]Default control[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Open the current greenhouse map[/td]
[td]M, while inside[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]View a greenhouse remotely[/td]
[td]Shift + M[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Show or hide the vegetation list[/td]
[td]L or the vegetation list button[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Zoom[/td]
[td]Mouse wheel over the map[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Pan[/td]
[td]Click and drag the map[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Scroll the vegetation list[/td]
[td]Mouse wheel over the list[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Focus on a plant[/td]
[td]Click its list entry[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Favorite a plant[/td]
[td]Checkbox beside its name[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Export the current view[/td]
[td]Export UI PNG[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Close the map[/td]
[td]Escape, a configured map hotkey, or the close button[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]Both map-opening shortcuts can be changed through Generic Mod Config Menu. Saving applies your new bindings without restarting the game.

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4][u]Requirements[/u][/size][/color][/b]
 
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or newer[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.14.1 or newer[/*]
[/list][b] [/b]
[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4][u]Installation[/u][/size][/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Extract the Greenhouse Mapper folder from the download into your game’s mods folder—or import the ZIP through Stardrop (recommended since it will alert you when the mod gets an update!)[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Enter your greenhouse and press M.[/*]
[/list]For remote viewing, visit the greenhouse at least once first. Safe to remove whenever as well.

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4][u]Compatibility and notes[/u][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Greenhouse Mapper builds its overview from the loaded location rather than assuming vanilla dimensions. It supports altered greenhouse layouts and includes compatibility handling for some custom bushes.[/*]
[*]Custom locations must be recognized by the game as greenhouses to appear in the mapper. Unusual item or bush frameworks may require additional compatibility support. If people ask nicely I can see about adding support for other custom crops.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]Spend less time hunting through your greenhouse—and more time enjoying what you grow![/size][/color][/b]
